title: “Religion builds walls… but the Spirit breaks chains.
paragraphs:
“Religion builds walls… but the Spirit breaks chains.
When God steps in, the barriers you thought defined you collapse in seconds.
Freedom isn’t found in rules — it’s found in His presence.
Let this be your reminder: the Holy Spirit doesn’t just touch lives… He transforms them.”
“Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.” — 2 Corinthians 3:17
